sources.title: agterm/Control/ControlServer.swift
sources.locator: class header comment: @MainActor, one request per connection
sources.finding: The control server is main-actor bound: each request is decoded on a background accept loop and executed on the main actor one at a time, one request per connection, so concurrent agtermctl callers are serialized.
